source: hand-constructed TextItems (geometry from measured Helvetica 12pt widths of 07-gap-space-rule.pdf dump)
changed: Not a pdf.js stream. Alpha/Beta with no intermediate space TextItem (wide gap); Glue/Me as separate runs with sub-threshold gap; Wi-/Fi for dehyphen. Real getTextContent() synthesizes a space between Alpha/Beta and merges GlueMe.
why: pdf.js merges runs and inserts its own space items, so the gap-rule branch fires zero times on all 10 verbatim fixture pages. Merging cannot be switched off with the vendored build: disableCombineTextItems was removed in pdf.js 3.0 and is absent from 3.11.174 (the 2026-08-05 probe-nocombine.js run passed an ignored option, which is why its two columns were identical). The branch still guards PDFs whose inter-run gap falls between pdf.js's space threshold and ours; our corpus does not contain one, so this stream is hand-built.
